resources.name: Getting started from scratch with Aseprite
Pixel logic
resources.desc: Pixel Logic is an in-depth pixel art tutorial book.

resources.name: Make Your Own Pixel Art
resources.desc: Walks you step-by-step through the available tools, pixel art techniques, the importance of shapes, colors, shading, and how to turn your art into animation.

resources.name: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island
resources.desc: Play as Yoshi carrying Baby Mario, platforming through a dangerous world. The painted feel and soft pastel colors create an hearth-warming handmade style that breathes the charm of a children’s book.

resources.name: FEZ
resources.desc: Explore a 2D retrofuturistic world by rotating in the third dimension. The minimalistic style, bright vibrant colors and dynamic lighting bring the 16-bit era into the future.

resources.name: Superbrothers: Sword & Sworcery EP
resources.desc: Laid back adventure in a bronze age mountain wilderness. Dreamy soft colors in a living world affected by moon phases.

resources.name: Undertale
resources.desc: A story-driven RPG where you explore a world of monsters. Turn-based combat. Retro 16-bit visuals, a rich narrative, and multiple endings based on your choices.

resources.name: Shovel Knight: Treasure Trove
resources.desc: Classic action adventure with an 8-bit retro aesthetic, taking the looks of a modern NES game.

resources.name: Hyper Light Drifter
resources.desc: Top-down action in a sci-fi world that radiates light and warmth. Using a colorful palette and kaleidoscopic neon yet setting a grim ambiance.

resources.name: Owlboy
resources.desc: Explore a detailed steampunk world in the clouds. With it's range of endearing animations and expressions the world and it's characters come to life.

resources.name: Stardew Valley
resources.desc: Manage a farm from a top-down perspective and engage with a charming and cheerful world in 16-bit.

resources.name: Starbound
resources.desc: Travel across vibrant, colorful and expansive galaxies, including creative dynamic animations.

resources.name: Void Golf
resources.desc: Shoot giant pieces of space rock into black holes, using gravitational fields, physics-defying walls and wormholes in a minimalist top-down view.

resources.name: Minit
resources.desc: With a minimalistic design (only two colors palette). Minit is an adventure where each exploration journey is limited to 60 seconds.

resources.name: Sean Browning - Pixel Art Animation Reel 2018
resources.desc: A collection of Sean Browning's pixel animations, ranging from simple scenes to recreations of popular shows like Steven's Universe and RWBY.

resources.name: Pixel Paul - An Interview with Pixel Artist and Animator Paul Veer
resources.desc: Paul Veer, a professional pixel artist with work on games such as Super Crate Box, shares his interest in pixel art as well as his workflow and style breakdown.

resources.name: MortMort channel
resources.desc: Creative videos & streams including tips, discussions and tutorials.

resources.name: Lospec palette list
resources.desc: Collection of color palettes for pixel art with examples and artist information.

resources.name: eBoy
resources.desc: German, pixel art group founded in 1997 by Kai Vermehr, Steffen Sauerteig and Svend Smital. They are regarded as the “Godfathers of Pixel Art”.

resources.name: Paul Robertson
resources.desc: Australian, creating cute, sometimes cosmic and psychedelic, and sometimes weird nightmarish pixel art.

resources.name: Syosa
resources.desc: Japanese, girlish style using bright and organic color palettes creating cute humans and animals.

resources.name: Thomas Feichtmeir
resources.desc: Australian, dark and mature: fan of knights, dinosaurs, pirates, epic beasts, anatomy and history as well as everything twisted and weird.

resources.name: Toyoi Yuuta
resources.desc: Australian, capturing small animated scenes of everyday life in unsaturated colors.

resources.name: Slynyrd
resources.desc: American, game designer with tons of material, game specific knowledge and mini-tutorials.

resources.name: Aseprite
resources.desc: Paid and source-available, works on Linux, macOS and Windows. Awesome UI with a lot of nifty tools to ease pixel art creation.

resources.name: Pixen
resources.desc: Paid, works on macOS and iOS. Superb OS integration, create pixel art on a tablet using pressure-sensitive drawing.

resources.name: Pro Motion
resources.desc: Paid with trial, works on Windows. Advanced features tailored to creating pixel art for games.

resources.name: GIMP
resources.desc: Open source and free, works on Linux, macOS and Windows. Not specifically for creating pixel art but is more than capable to do so.

resources.name: PixelCraft
resources.desc: Open source and free, works in the browser. Easy to try out in the browser and as a PWA offline.

resources.name: rx
resources.desc: Open source and free, works on Linux, macOS and Windows. Minimalist and keyboard driven with animation support.

resources.name: Wobblepaint
resources.desc: Pico8 editor that give life to pixel art with a little wobble.

resources.name: Pixelrepo
resources.desc: Free and works in the browser. Import files and palettes, save locally. Minimalist, easy to use, and perfect for quick pixel art editing.

resources.name: Draw!
resources.desc: Editor for creating tiny GIF animations. Open source and free, works in the browser.

resources.name: Tessarium
resources.desc: Free with paid upgrade, works on Linux, macOS, Windows and in the browser. Tile-first level editor where editing a tile updates every placement.

resources.name: Broider
resources.desc: Make 9-patch borders, export as CSS.

resources.name: pixeldudesmaker
resources.desc: Small character generator, including basic animation.

resources.name: PixelArtChallenge
resources.desc: Pixel art recreation challenges, practice solo or compete in real-time 1v1 matches.

resources.name: Palette Extractor
resources.desc: Free and works in the browser. Pull a sprite's exact palette, export .gpl, Lospec .hex, CSS or JSON.
